author: "Sean McWeeny"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
rm(list = ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(jsonlite)
library(visNetwork)

source("../code/cleaning_functions.R")
```

# Belmonte

```{r load-belmonte}
temp <- load.graphs(theory = "Belmonte")
invisible(list2env(temp, envir = .GlobalEnv))



j.s.list <- compare.pair(g1 = j.clean, g2 = s.clean, g1.name = "j", g2.name = "s")
gemini.j.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gemini.clean, g2 = j.clean, g1.name = "gemini", g2.name = "j")
gpt.j.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gpt.clean, g2 = j.clean, g1.name = "gpt", g2.name = "j")
gemini.s.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gemini.clean, g2 = s.clean, g1.name = "gemini", g2.name = "s")
gpt.s.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gpt.clean, g2 = s.clean, g1.name = "gpt", g2.name = "s")
gpt.gemini.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gpt.clean, g2 = gemini.clean, g1.name = "gpt", g2.name = "gemini")

invisible(list2env(j.s.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gemini.j.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gemini.s.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gpt.j.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gpt.s.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gpt.gemini.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))

```

## TE1-TE2: Belmonte

```{r}
cmp <- cmp.j.s
mcs <- mcs.j.s

report.table.j.s <- c(Coder1 = "TE1", Coder2 = "TE2", SharedNodes = length(cmp$shared_nodes), Coder1_unique_nodes = length(cmp$unique_nodes1), Coder2_unique_nodes = length(cmp$unique_nodes2), Jaccard_Nodes = round(cmp$jaccard_nodes, 3), Jaccard_Edges_Raw = round(cmp$jaccard_raw_edges, 3), Jaccard_Edges_Closure = round(cmp$jaccard_edges_shared_nodes,3))

```

#### Nodes only present in J:

```{r}
print(cmp$unique_nodes1)
```
#### Nodes only present in S:

```{r}
print(cmp$unique_nodes2)
```

#### Paths only present in J (after dropping unique nodes):

```{r}
print(cmp$only1)
```
#### Paths only present in S (after dropping unique nodes):
```{r}
print(cmp$only2)
```
#### Nodes removed to reach 100% agreement: 
```{r}
print(mcs$removed)
```

### Maximum Consistent Subgraph Belmonte

Find the largest subset of shared nodes such that the induced ancestral relations (i.e., transitive closure) agree perfectly.


```{r belmonte-max-subgraph-plot-j-s}
g <- j.s.graph

nodes <- data.frame(id = V(g)$name, label = V(g)$name)

edges <- as_data_frame(g, what = "edges")# %>% 
#  drop_cycles_for_visnetwork() 

visNetwork(nodes, edges) %>%
  visHierarchicalLayout(direction = "LR", sortMethod = "directed") %>%
  visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE) %>% 
  visEdges(arrows = "to", width = .01)


```

### Latent Projection (Strict): Belmonte

```{r latent-projection-belmonte-j-s}
g <- j.s.strict.graph

nodes <- data.frame(id = V(g)$name, label = V(g)$name)

edges <- as_data_frame(g, what = "edges") #%>% 
  #drop_cycles_for_visnetwork() 

visNetwork(nodes, edges) %>%
  visHierarchicalLayout(direction = "LR", sortMethod = "directed") %>%  # left-to-right DAG
  visInteraction(navigationButtons = TRUE) %>% 
  visEdges(arrows = "to")
```

# Baron-Cohen


```{r read-baron-cohen}
temp <- load.graphs(theory = "Baron-Cohen")
invisible(list2env(temp, envir = .GlobalEnv))

j.s.list <- compare.pair(g1 = j.clean, g2 = s.clean, g1.name = "j", g2.name = "s")
gemini.j.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gemini.clean, g2 = j.clean, g1.name = "gemini", g2.name = "j")
gpt.j.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gpt.clean, g2 = j.clean, g1.name = "gpt", g2.name = "j")
gemini.s.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gemini.clean, g2 = s.clean, g1.name = "gemini", g2.name = "s")
gpt.s.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gpt.clean, g2 = s.clean, g1.name = "gpt", g2.name = "s")
gpt.gemini.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gpt.clean, g2 = gemini.clean, g1.name = "gpt", g2.name = "gemini")

invisible(list2env(j.s.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gemini.j.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gemini.s.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gpt.j.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gpt.s.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gpt.gemini.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))


```

# Gepner


```{r read-Gepner}
temp <- load.graphs(theory = "Gepner")
invisible(list2env(temp, envir = .GlobalEnv))


j.s.list <- compare.pair(g1 = j.clean, g2 = s.clean, g1.name = "j", g2.name = "s")
gemini.j.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gemini.clean, g2 = j.clean, g1.name = "gemini", g2.name = "j")
gpt.j.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gpt.clean, g2 = j.clean, g1.name = "gpt", g2.name = "j")
gemini.s.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gemini.clean, g2 = s.clean, g1.name = "gemini", g2.name = "s")
gpt.s.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gpt.clean, g2 = s.clean, g1.name = "gpt", g2.name = "s")
gpt.gemini.list <- compare.pair(g1 = gpt.clean, g2 = gemini.clean, g1.name = "gpt", g2.name = "gemini")

invisible(list2env(j.s.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gemini.j.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gemini.s.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gpt.j.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gpt.s.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))
invisible(list2env(gpt.gemini.list, envir = .GlobalEnv))


```

## The Grand Conclusion

```{r}
report.table.belmonte$theory = "Belmonte"
report.table.gepner$theory = "Gepner"
report.table.baron.cohen$theory = "Baron-Cohen"

report.table.summary <- bind_rows(report.table.belmonte, report.table.baron.cohen, report.table.gepner)

DT::datatable(report.table.summary %>% group_by(Coder1, Coder2) %>% summarize(Coder1_Unique = round(mean(as.numeric(Coder1_unique_nodes)),3),
                                                                             Coder2_unique = round(mean(as.numeric(Coder2_unique_nodes)), 3),
                                                                             SharedNodes = round(mean(as.numeric(SharedNodes)), 3),
                                                                            Jaccard_Nodes = round(mean(as.numeric(Jaccard_Nodes)),3), 
                                                                             Jaccard_Edges_Raw = round(mean(as.numeric(Jaccard_Edges_Raw)),3),
                                                                             Jaccard_Edges_Closure = round(mean(as.numeric(Jaccard_Edges_Closure)),3)))


```
